title: Base
subtitle: 「基礎／依據／基地／據點」，必須按語義分支理解。
description: 「基礎／依據／基地／據點」，必須按語義分支理解。

words.example: Basic literacy provides a foundation for later learning.
words.exampleZh: 基本讀寫能力為日後學習提供基礎。

exercises.original: Basic numeracy forms the base for more advanced mathematics.
exercises.zh: 基本數學能力構成更高階數學的基礎。
exercises.upgrade: Basic numeracy forms the foundation for more advanced mathematics.

options.explanation: more advanced mathematics 是建立在 basic numeracy 之上的後續能力，foundation 最自然。
只表示最低部分，不能表示學習基礎。
是地面／地板，不符抽象能力。
起源不等於支撐其上的學習根基。

exercises.original: Trust is the base of a strong working relationship.
exercises.zh: 信任是穩固工作關係的基礎。
exercises.upgrade: Trust is the foundation of a strong working relationship.

options.explanation: 可說 root cause，但 relationship 的支撐根基更自然是 foundation。
strong relationship 建立在 trust 之上。

exercises.original: The programme gives beginners a solid base in spoken English.
exercises.zh: 這個課程為初學者建立穩固的英語口語基礎。
exercises.upgrade: The programme gives beginners a solid foundation in spoken English.

options.explanation: solid foundation in a subject/skill 是高頻搭配。

words.example: The survey provides a useful basis for future planning.
words.exampleZh: 這項調查為未來規劃提供有用依據。

exercises.original: The survey will provide a base for future policy decisions.
exercises.zh: 這項調查將為未來政策決定提供依據。
exercises.upgrade: The survey will provide a basis for future policy decisions.

options.explanation: policy decisions 需要 evidence/grounds 作依據，basis 很自然。
調查可以是資料來源，但 provide a source for decisions 不如 basis 精準。

exercises.original: These figures form the base of our calculation.
exercises.zh: 這些數字構成我們計算的依據。
exercises.upgrade: These figures form the basis of our calculation.

options.explanation: 可理解，但 calculation 的直接依據更自然是 basis。
basis of a calculation 是自然搭配。
數字可能來自 source，但不是 calculation 本身的 basis 同義。

exercises.original: The agreement creates a legal base for cooperation.
exercises.zh: 這項協議為合作建立法律依據。
exercises.upgrade: The agreement creates a legal basis for cooperation.

options.explanation: 法律來源與法律依據不同。
legal basis for cooperation 是固定常見搭配。

words.example: The pilot study laid the groundwork for a larger research project.
words.exampleZh: 試點研究為更大型研究項目奠定了基礎。

exercises.original: The early meetings created the base for later negotiations.
exercises.zh: 早期會議為之後談判奠定基礎。
exercises.upgrade: The early meetings laid the groundwork for later negotiations.

options.explanation: early meetings + later negotiations 明確是先期準備為後續鋪路。
只是起點，不表達準備工作。

exercises.original: The pilot project formed the base for a national programme.
exercises.zh: 試點項目為全國計劃打下基礎。
exercises.upgrade: The pilot project laid the groundwork for a national programme.

options.explanation: 也可，但 pilot project 為後續 national programme 鋪路，groundwork 更精準。
具有明確前期準備 → 後續發展關係。
可比喻，但不及 groundwork 精確。

exercises.original: Months of research provided the base for the final proposal.
exercises.zh: 數月研究為最終建議奠定了準備基礎。
exercises.upgrade: Months of research provided the groundwork for the final proposal.

options.explanation: research 可能提供資料來源，但題意是前期準備。
months of research 為 final proposal 作準備。

words.example: Trust is an important underpinning of effective teamwork.
words.exampleZh: 信任是有效團隊合作的重要支撐基礎。

exercises.original: Shared values are the base of the organisation's culture.
exercises.zh: 共同價值觀是該機構文化的根本支撐。
exercises.upgrade: Shared values are an underpinning of the organisation's culture.

options.explanation: shared values 在深層支撐 organisational culture，符合抽象結構性支撐。

exercises.original: The theory provides the base for the new analytical framework.
exercises.zh: 這套理論為新分析框架提供理論支撐。
exercises.upgrade: The theory provides the underpinning for the new analytical framework.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 theory 作 framework 的深層理論支撐時 underpinning 更正式精準。

exercises.original: Stable funding is a key base of the service model.
exercises.zh: 穩定資金是這套服務模式的重要支撐。
exercises.upgrade: Stable funding is a key underpinning of the service model.

options.explanation: funding source 是資金來源，但本句說的是整體模式的支柱。
stable funding 支撐 service model 的運作。

words.example: The new funding put the organisation on a firmer footing.
words.exampleZh: 新資金令該機構建立在更穩固的基礎上。

exercises.original: The new funding placed the organisation on a stronger base.
exercises.zh: 新資金令該機構建立在更穩固基礎上。
exercises.upgrade: The new funding placed the organisation on a stronger footing.

options.explanation: put/place an organisation on a stronger footing 是固定自然搭配。
意思相近，但 on a stronger foundation 在此不如 footing 的慣用搭配自然。

exercises.original: The reforms put the pension system on a more secure base.
exercises.zh: 改革令退休金制度建立在更穩妥基礎上。
exercises.upgrade: The reforms put the pension system on a more secure footing.

options.explanation: 可說 basis of system，但 put ... on a secure basis 不如 footing 慣用。
secure footing 正好表示更穩固的運作狀態。

exercises.original: The business is now on a sound financial base.
exercises.zh: 企業目前處於穩健的財務基礎上。
exercises.upgrade: The business is now on a sound financial footing.

options.explanation: 意思可理解，但 financial footing 是固定搭配。
財務來源不是財務狀況。
sound financial footing 表示穩健財務基礎。

words.example: The team uses the building as its main research site.
words.exampleZh: 團隊以這座建築作為主要研究地點。

exercises.original: The old warehouse became the team's base for field research.
exercises.zh: 舊貨倉成為團隊進行實地研究的基地。
exercises.upgrade: The old warehouse became the team's research site.

options.explanation: warehouse 作為實際研究地點，research site 很自然。
如果不是主要行政總部，語義過強。

exercises.original: The laboratory serves as the main base for the study.
exercises.zh: 實驗室是這項研究的主要地點。
exercises.upgrade: The laboratory serves as the main site for the study.

options.explanation: 可表示研究中心，但句子只是 study 的所在地。
main site for the study 最中性精準。

exercises.original: The project uses three regional bases to collect samples.
exercises.zh: 項目使用三個區域地點收集樣本。
exercises.upgrade: The project uses three regional sites to collect samples.

options.explanation: 收集樣本的地方未必是辦公室。
多個 sample-collection locations 最適合 sites。

words.example: The organisation moved its headquarters to a larger building.
words.exampleZh: 該機構把總部遷到更大的大樓。

exercises.original: The charity moved its main base to a larger building.
exercises.zh: 慈善機構把主要總部遷到更大的大樓。
exercises.upgrade: The charity moved its headquarters to a larger building.

options.explanation: main administrative base 對應 headquarters。
可是活動中心，但不一定是行政總部。
branch 是分部，不是主要總部。

exercises.original: The company's base is in Singapore, where senior management works.
exercises.zh: 公司的總部位於新加坡，高層管理人員在那裡工作。
exercises.upgrade: The company's headquarters is in Singapore, where senior management works.

options.explanation: 可是辦公室，但 senior management + company base 更明確是 headquarters。
指主要行政管理所在地。

exercises.original: The agency established a new regional base for its administrative team.
exercises.zh: 該機構為行政團隊設立新的區域總部。
exercises.upgrade: The agency established new regional headquarters for its administrative team.

options.explanation: 可是中心，但行政 team 的主要據點更像 headquarters。
branch 是機構分支本身，不是同一語義。

words.example: The city serves as a regional centre for medical research.
words.exampleZh: 該城市是區內醫學研究中心。

exercises.original: The city is a major base for medical research.
exercises.zh: 該城市是醫學研究的重要中心。
exercises.upgrade: The city is a major centre for medical research.

options.explanation: city 作為 medical research 活動集中地，centre 很自然。
不可能是所有研究的單一總部。
可，但 major centre 更能表達集中活動。

exercises.original: The building serves as a training base for new staff.
exercises.zh: 這座大樓是新員工的培訓中心。
exercises.upgrade: The building serves as a training centre for new staff.

options.explanation: 也可，但 training centre 是更自然、功能更明確的搭配。
指專門進行培訓的活動中心。

exercises.original: The town became a regional base for emergency coordination.
exercises.zh: 小鎮成為區內緊急協調中心。
exercises.upgrade: The town became a regional centre for emergency coordination.

options.explanation: regional centre for coordination 很自然。

words.example: The hotel served as the team's base of operations during the survey.
words.exampleZh: 調查期間，酒店作為團隊的行動基地。

exercises.original: The hotel was the team's base during the two-week survey.
exercises.zh: 兩星期調查期間，酒店是團隊的行動基地。
exercises.upgrade: The hotel was the team's base of operations during the two-week survey.

options.explanation: temporary team + survey + hotel，明確是由此開展活動的據點。
對兩星期臨時團隊來說過於正式。

exercises.original: The camp served as a base for rescue teams working in the area.
exercises.zh: 營地作為救援隊在區內行動的基地。
exercises.upgrade: The camp served as a base of operations for rescue teams working in the area.

options.explanation: 只表示位置，沒有『由此開展救援』功能。
rescue teams working in area 是典型 operation base 語境。
可能，但不及 base of operations 直接。

exercises.original: The rented office became our base while we worked across the region.
exercises.zh: 我們在區內工作期間，租用辦公室成為行動據點。
exercises.upgrade: The rented office became our base of operations while we worked across the region.

options.explanation: 可表示地點，但缺少『由此在整區工作』意味。
across the region 明確顯示據點功能。

words.example: The airport became the airline's main operating base.
words.exampleZh: 該機場成為航空公司的主要營運基地。

exercises.original: The airport is the airline's main base.
exercises.zh: 這個機場是航空公司的主要營運基地。
exercises.upgrade: The airport is the airline's main operating base.

options.explanation: airline + airport 是典型 operating base 搭配。
航空公司總部未必在主要營運機場。

exercises.original: The rescue service opened a second base in the north.
exercises.zh: 救援服務在北部開設第二個營運基地。
exercises.upgrade: The rescue service opened a second operating base in the north.

options.explanation: 可成立，但 operating base 更強調日常行動據點。
rescue service 有多個營運基地很自然。
second headquarters 語義通常不合。

exercises.original: The company plans to establish a new overseas base next year.
exercises.zh: 公司計劃明年設立新的海外營運基地。
exercises.upgrade: The company plans to establish a new overseas operating base next year.

options.explanation: establish + overseas + regular operations 很自然。
可能是組織單位，但不等於據點。

words.example: The city has become a regional hub for technology companies.
words.exampleZh: 該城市已成為區內科技公司的樞紐。

exercises.original: The city has become an important base for technology companies.
exercises.zh: 該城市已成為科技公司的重要樞紐。
exercises.upgrade: The city has become an important hub for technology companies.

options.explanation: technology companies 集中且互相連接，tech hub 是常見搭配。
太中性，不能表達產業集中。
不可能是所有公司的共同總部。

exercises.original: The port is a major base for regional logistics.
exercises.zh: 這個港口是區域物流的重要樞紐。
exercises.upgrade: The port is a major hub for regional logistics.

options.explanation: 也可，但 logistics hub 是更固定、更強調連接網絡的搭配。
港口與 regional logistics 的連接功能非常吻合。

exercises.original: The airport acts as a base connecting flights across the region.
exercises.zh: 該機場作為連接區內航班的樞紐。
exercises.upgrade: The airport acts as a hub connecting flights across the region.

options.explanation: connecting flights 是典型 airport hub 語境。

words.example: Mutual trust is the bedrock of a strong partnership.
words.exampleZh: 互相信任是穩固伙伴關係的根本基礎。

exercises.original: Trust is the base of a lasting partnership.
exercises.zh: 信任是長久伙伴關係的根本基礎。
exercises.upgrade: Trust is the bedrock of a lasting partnership.

options.explanation: lasting partnership + trust 強調最根本、最可靠的支柱。
不是只說伙伴關係從 trust 開始。

exercises.original: Independent courts are a base of the rule of law.
exercises.zh: 獨立法院是法治的根本基礎。
exercises.upgrade: Independent courts are a bedrock of the rule of law.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 bedrock 更強調不可動搖的根本制度支柱。
rule of law 的核心根基，修辭上自然。

exercises.original: Reliable evidence should be the base of scientific claims.
exercises.zh: 可靠證據應是科學主張的根本基礎。
exercises.upgrade: Reliable evidence should be the bedrock of scientific claims.

options.explanation: evidence 可來自 source，但本句說它是 claims 的根本支撐。
強調 evidence 作為不可缺少的核心根基。

words.example: The existing data provides a useful starting point for the review.
words.exampleZh: 現有資料為這次檢討提供有用的出發點。

exercises.original: The existing data gives us a useful base for further analysis.
exercises.zh: 現有資料為進一步分析提供有用起點。
exercises.upgrade: The existing data gives us a useful starting point for further analysis.

options.explanation: further analysis 明確是從現有資料開始。
可理解，但這裡更偏起始材料而非長期支撐。
origin 是事物來源，不是分析起點的自然搭配。
資料本身可能是來源，但句型要表達分析起點。

exercises.original: This draft provides a base for discussion.
exercises.zh: 這份草稿為討論提供起點。
exercises.upgrade: This draft provides a starting point for discussion.

options.explanation: 也可，但 draft 在討論前作初始材料時 starting point 更自然。
starting point for discussion 是固定自然搭配。
語義較偏提供機會／渠道。

exercises.original: The checklist is only a base and can be adapted later.
exercises.zh: 這份清單只是一個起點，之後可以調整。
exercises.upgrade: The checklist is only a starting point and can be adapted later.

options.explanation: 語氣太像穩固根基，不符合 can be adapted later 的暫時起點。
only + adapted later 明確表示只是初始版本。

words.example: The apartment became our home base while we explored the region.
words.exampleZh: 我們探索該地區期間，這個單位成為我們的主要據點。

exercises.original: The apartment was our base while we explored the region.
exercises.zh: 我們探索該地區期間，這個單位是主要據點。
exercises.upgrade: The apartment was our home base while we explored the region.

options.explanation: temporary familiar place + explored region 是典型 home base。

exercises.original: The team returned to its base after each day of fieldwork.
exercises.zh: 團隊每天實地工作後都返回主要據點。
exercises.upgrade: The team returned to its home base after each day of fieldwork.

options.explanation: 只說地點，沒有『每天回去的固定據點』意味。
returned to + regular familiar base 非常自然。
fieldwork team 未必有正式總部。

exercises.original: We used the guesthouse as a base for day trips.
exercises.zh: 我們以旅館作為每日短途旅行的據點。
exercises.upgrade: We used the guesthouse as a home base for day trips.

options.explanation: 只是位置，缺少『由此出發再返回』感。
day trips + guesthouse 完全符合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 底部不等於所有 base bottom 只表示最低部分；base 可表示底座、基礎、基地或依據。某物的 base 可能是 bottom，但抽象 base 不能一律換成 bottom。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The bottom is the lowest part; a base may also be a foundation, headquarters, or point of support.

falseSynonyms.zh: 地板不等於 base floor 是房間或空間的地面；base 是支撐物、底部或據點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A table stands on the floor, but its base is part of the table.

falseSynonyms.zh: 根源不等於 base root 可表示原因、來源或植物根部；有時與 foundation 有比喻重疊，但不能普遍替換 base。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The root of a problem is its underlying cause; the base may simply be its support or operational centre.

falseSynonyms.zh: 起源不等於 base origin 指某事最初從哪裡開始；base 更常指支撐點或據點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An origin explains where something began; a base explains what supports it or where it operates from.

falseSynonyms.zh: 分部不等於基地 branch 是機構的分支辦事處；base 可以是任何營運據點，未必是正式組織分部。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A branch is an organisational unit; a base is a place from which operations are carried out.

falseSynonyms.zh: 辦公室不等於 base office 是辦公場所；base 可以是辦公室，但也可以是實驗室、營地、機場或其他據點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An office may function as a base, but the terms are not equivalent.

falseSynonyms.zh: 來源不等於 base source 是資訊、材料或事物的來源；basis/base 是依據或支撐。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A source provides information or material; a basis provides grounds or support.

falseSynonyms.zh: 平台不等於 base platform 可指實體平台、科技平台或發言舞台；只有某些比喻語境與 foundation 有重疊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A platform may enable activity, but it is not generally a synonym for base.
